blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Out of the estimated 288,000 people living with HIV (PLHIV) in the Philippines in the first quarter of 2026, only 56 percent had been diagnosed as of June, according to the latest figures from the Department of Health (DOH). The DOH recorded 159,997 people living with HIV who had been diagnosed or laboratory-confirmed as of June. This leaves a gap of about 128,003 between the estimated number of PLHIV and those who have been diagnosed. The health department also recorded 2,994 newly diagnosed HIV cases from April to June 2026, a 39 percent decrease from the same period […]...
